project.name: Blood Bank Dispatch
project.summary: A CALL-E phone agent that checks multiple blood banks and returns a ranked, auditable stock shortlist for qualified clinic staff.
project.ai_usage: CALL-E conducts authorized mock-line calls and extracts stock, release, screening, transport, cost, contact, callback, and alternative data into a strict schema.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped plan, implement, harden, test, and document the FastAPI/Postgres application and prepare its demo and Devpost materials.
